description.public:
A roll of clean linen, a pot of herbal salve, needle and gut, and a small bottle of spirit for washing wounds. With a night's rest to work in, a careful hand can close injuries that rest alone would leave open for days.

Use it after a Rest to treat Wounds, the deep injuries that a night's sleep barely touches. It does nothing for a hero who has not rested, and nothing for a troubled mind.
description.private:
GM notes

  • Crucible’s Rest removes only level-many Wounds, so a level 1 hero gets back 1 Wound a night. The kit closes that gap without making Wounds free.

  • Standard (5 Wounds, 3 gp) matches the cleric Briannon in Ember’s Glinthome, who heals 5 Wounds for 1 gp. The temple is cheaper; the kit works in the field.

  • One kit per hero per Rest, used straight after the Rest, on themselves or an adjacent ally. Never in combat.

  • Prices scale by quality from the 3 gp base: 1.5 / 3 / 24 / 81 / 375 gp for 3 / 5 / 10 / 20 / 40 Wounds.

  • A natural seller is the alchemy room at Traveler’s Rest in Ordain, where the Cindarics brew curative draughts.

  • Crucible Shop’s default shop and character creation list it automatically. The module setting “Paul’s Items in shops and character creation” turns that off.

actions.name: Treat Wounds
actions.description:
Use the @ref[item.name] straight after a Rest to treat yourself or an adjacent ally. The target recovers @Rule[resource.wounds]{Wounds} dependent on the quality of the kit, on top of what the Rest restored. Each hero can use one kit per Rest.

  • Shoddy - Recover 3 Wounds.

  • Standard - Recover 5 Wounds.

  • Fine - Recover 10 Wounds.

  • Superior - Recover 20 Wounds.

  • Masterwork - Recover 40 Wounds.
